title: Alarm status shown only as 'Meldet sich nicht' with no plain explanation
expected: A landlord can tell at a glance what is wrong and what it means for the tenant
actual: The overview and task list say 'Meldet sich nicht' and 'Vor Ort prüfen: Strom und Netzwerk der Basisstation' but do not say whether heating is affected or whether a visit is urgent

title: Technical jargon on the apartment technical view
expected: Plain-language status such as 'Uhr falsch gestellt, 19 Minuten' or 'Heizung läuft normal'
actual: Shows 'Uhrabweichung 1134.0 s', 'Protokollversion 9', 'Sollzustand bearbeiten', 'Fail-closed Vorprüfung des Agenten, Pilotbetrieb erforderlich' and 'Letzte Regelentscheidung vor 4 Tagen' with no explanation

title: Tenant change page is unclear about what gets deleted
expected: Simple words on what the new tenant will and will not inherit, and what happens to the device
actual: Confirm page lists token invalidation, deletion of heartbeats, alarms and log extracts, and that backups and audit log stay, but gives no clear 'what this means for the flat' summary and no way to check the device is reachable first; the flat is currently 'Meldet sich nicht'

title: Alarm name 'Hängender Sensor' has no explanation
expected: A short sentence saying what it means and what to do
actual: Shows 'Hängender Sensor · Zone zone-2' with a 'Quittieren' button and optional note field, no meaning given

title: Update section says 'abgeschaltet' with no consequence
expected: Clear note whether heating or tenant is affected
actual: 'Update-Ausführung ist derzeit abgeschaltet' and 'Ein gesetzter Sollzustand löst derzeit keine Aktualisierung am Gerät aus' leave the landlord unsure whether to act

title: Landlord edit form exposes the pilot-mode toggle for the open_access command
expected: Internal command gating is not a landlord-facing setting, or at least is clearly restricted
actual: Wohnung bearbeiten form shows a checkbox 'Pilotbetrieb (schaltet den Agent-Befehl "open_access" frei)' to the landlord role; I did not change it

title: No overview of what needs doing per flat in plain words
expected: A single list with each flat's problem and next step
actual: Had to combine overview, task list and technical view to understand one flat; the headline counts ('Handlungsbedarf 7, + 2 weitere') don't map to the listed tasks

title: Browse tools cannot fill or submit form fields
expected: Fill the required 'Grund' field on the command confirm page and press 'Bestätigen', as a person would in a browser
actual: `browse text` only lists links and text, and the confirm page's form action is not exposed. I could not enter a reason or submit either the 'Sofort melden' or the 'Diagnosepaket erstellen' command, so neither maintenance command nor the diagnostic bundle could be run.

title: Fault on sim-a09 has no visible route to act on it from the task list
expected: The open fault 'Fensteralarm' (zone-3) on sim-a09 can be looked at and acknowledged, with a clear next step
actual: The task list only links to the apartment overview. The fault and its 'Quittieren' button sit on the 'Störung' tab, and the task itself does not say what to do. The guidance text only says to check the base station first.

title: Event dates are later than today's date
expected: Events up to today, 2026-01-05
actual: The 'Zuletzt passiert' list shows events dated 12.01., 09:00 Uhr, which is after today's simulated date.

title: Reachability wording is confusing
expected: Plain-language status for a caretaker
actual: The timeline shows 'von < 1 Min. bis < 1 Min. · 5 Herzschläge' and 'Lücke ... · 7 Tagen' with no clear meaning, and it says '< 1 Min.' for every entry.

title: Dashboard shows the same 'seit < 1 Min.' for every item
expected: Relative times that differ for different events
actual: Every offline, battery, and task item reads 'seit < 1 Min.' or 'vor < 1 Min.', so the list gives no sense of what is urgent.

title: No backup overview or retention settings anywhere in the admin UI
expected: A place to see backup age per apartment and the retention period (how long backups are kept), so I can check retention for the whole portfolio
actual: The dashboard shows 'Letzte Sicherungen 0 / 12 · Noch keine Sicherung' with no link. The only backup view is per apartment under Wartung ('Sicherungen: Keine Sicherungen für diese Wohnung'). Retention is not shown or configurable anywhere I could find.

title: Backup dashboard shows 0/12 with no explanation of why
expected: Either a backup schedule note or a reason (e.g. backups not yet enabled) next to the 0/12 count
actual: Only 'Noch keine Sicherung' is shown; it is unclear whether backups are expected to run at all or are failing

title: Event timestamps are later than the simulated date
expected: Events on or before today's simulated date, 2026-01-05
actual: The 'Zuletzt passiert' entries are dated 12.01., 09:00 Uhr, which is after today

title: Rollout page offers 'Neuer Rollout' but creation is disabled
expected: Clear indication up front that no rollout can be planned yet, or the button hidden
actual: 'Neuer Rollout' is shown as a normal button, and the explanation ('Update-Ausführung derzeit abgeschaltet') appears only on the page itself. I could not plan the rollout I wanted to plan.

title: Apartment names repeat the house name in every label
expected: Short, scannable labels
actual: Labels read 'Haus Bahnhofstrasse 12 · Haus Bahnhofstrasse 12 / EG Mitte', so the house name appears twice

title: Onboarding steps don't say which fields are needed or where to get them
expected: A newcomer can tell what to enter to register a base station before starting
actual: 'Gerät registrieren' is a bare form with Seriennummer, Modell, Anschaffungsdatum, Image-Version and Watchdog-Version, all required, and no help text or explanation of where these values come from

title: Confirm page is hard to find the purpose of
expected: The page explains what confirming a device does and where a device appears when it is waiting
actual: 'Geräteregistrierung bestätigen' only says 'Keine Geräte warten auf Bestätigung.' with no explanation of how a device gets there or what I should expect after the base station is connected on site

title: Event timestamps are dated after today's date
expected: Events on the overview show dates on or before the simulated date 2026-01-05
actual: 'Zuletzt passiert' lists 'Basisstation nicht erreichbar' and 'wieder erreichbar' entries dated 12.01., which is after today's date

title: No way to read the page's form fields in text mode
expected: The text view shows form inputs and their current values, so I can see what a form needs
actual: The browse text output lists only labels and 'Pflichtfeld' markers, not input types, options or placeholders, so I cannot tell what format Anschaffungsdatum or Image-Version expects

title: Alarm text is full of technical terms for a non-technical landlord
expected: A plain-language explanation of what the alarm means and what to do
actual: The apartment page uses terms like 'Herzschlag', 'Zone zone-2', 'Zigbee-Bridge', 'Basisstation' and 'Lücke' with no explanation. The 'Hängender Sensor' alarm shows only 'Zone zone-2 · seit 7 Tagen' with an 'Hinweis (optional)' field and a 'Quittieren' button, and nothing says what it means or what to do.

title: Status 'Meldet sich nicht' contradicts 'Erreichbar' on the same page
expected: A consistent status for the apartment
actual: The header says 'Meldet sich nicht' and 'Vor Ort prüfen', but the Erreichbarkeit table shows 'Letzter Kontakt vor < 1 Min.' with 'Erreichbar' and '1 Herzschlag'. The gap rows read 'Keine Rückmeldung' next to 'Erreichbar', and the gap labels read oddly ('1 Tag bis < 1 Min.').

title: Tasks list shows 'seit < 1 Min.' for a just-raised item, and the priority hint is cryptic
expected: Plain wording for how long a problem has been open, and clear guidance on what to do first
actual: The task list shows 'seit < 1 Min.' and 'Meldet sich nicht' with no explanation of the consequence. The hint 'Priorität hat Erreichbarkeit' is vague, and 'Ansehen und quittieren' is unclear to a non-technical user.

title: Overview counts don't say which apartments need attention
expected: A count linked to the apartments it refers to
actual: The overview tile says 'Handlungsbedarf 10 · 3 nicht erreichbar · 3 Störungen · + 4 weitere' and 'Letzte Sicherungen 0 / 12 · Noch keine Sicherung' with no explanation of what a backup is. The 'Hier braucht es Sie' list is also unclear about the difference between tasks and alarms.

title: No flow to hand over a flat to a new tenant
expected: A tenant handover or move-in step for an apartment
actual: The Einrichtung page only offers 'Objekte & Wohnungen', 'Basisstationen', 'Neue Installation' and per-apartment 'edit' and 'replace-device' links. None of them is a tenant handover, and nothing mentions tenants.

title: Cannot see the apartment's history and status in plain words
expected: A plain summary of what happened, such as 'the base station was offline from X to Y'
actual: The 'Alarme' section shows only 'Meldet sich nicht' with 'ausgelöst vor' and 'beendet vor' timestamps, and the 'Vergangen' section is empty for the selected period.

title: Maintenance and diagnostic commands cannot be submitted from my tools
expected: Submit the 'Diagnosepaket erstellen' or 'Sofort melden' confirm form with a reason, then see the result
actual: The confirm pages require a 'Grund' field, and my browse tools only read pages, so the command could not be sent

title: Clock drift of -182 s and a 11-day-old control decision are not listed as faults
expected: A clock off by more than three minutes, or no control decision for 11 days, shows as a Störung or task
actual: Only the Bridge-Fehler and the zone sensor fault are listed; the Technik tab shows the drift and the old decision as plain values

title: Task timers say 'seit < 1 Min.' for faults that are minutes or days old
expected: Consistent durations, e.g. 'seit 7 Tagen' for the same kind of fault
actual: Some 'Meldet sich nicht' tasks show 'seit < 1 Min.' while the apartment page shows the last contact 3 minutes ago, which reads as contradictory

title: Bridge-Fehler is shown as open for 7 days, but the apartment is reachable now
expected: Clear guidance on whether the fault still applies or can be acknowledged after a recent contact
actual: The fault has an acknowledge button ('Quittieren') with an optional note, but no hint of what to check first, so it is unclear whether to fix the bridge or just acknowledge
